next_step.title: Confirm the 26 picks a person has not confirmed, 13 of them on the authority's own code
next_step.text: Twenty-five MQ disciplines carry the code the data votes for most and one carries a code it shares; no person has confirmed them. Thirteen of them sit on the authority's own code (CCN or C-ID), which the nightly cohort confirm settles once built (Sam ruled it on, Sheet 99, 16:37Z); the rest are a curator's picks on the Reference view. Then the one collision (AUTB), the thirteen weak mnemonics and the two modal choices without a note, each a finding on the Progress view.

changes.text: The first run log for this reference (the Commons' step 2), so its row on the Commons tab reads a session stamp and a next step.

The Progress view: the Commons' dash for this reference, with a card for each of Sam's eight steps, the procedures under the cards and a count that opens the filtered table (the Commons' step 3, the deep link behind a count).

The daily scan runs from the daily workflow and writes kb/csr_out/latest.json with every minted identity's code: 282 codes on 75,581 identities, 110 strays on 396; its missed-alignment rule honors a recorded note, so CMUS and HIT stop asking.
The handbook's discipline is the MQ discipline on the tab and the Commons row (Sam's word); the pick's reviewer is read from the code row, so eleven picks a person made no longer read as a cohort's.
Sam answered Open Asks Sheet 99's six cards, all his own call: settled, on, agab, sitting, hide, rename. The lane records them; Session 426 executes them, the nightly cohort confirm first.
